title: Scaling Collider Event Generation with Residual-Quantized Tokens
abstract: arXiv:2610.00569v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Full detector simulation and reconstruction of collider events are projected to become major bottlenecks at the High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider, motivating the development of fast, ML-based surrogates. At the same time, LLMs have driven fast progress in generative discrete modeling: autoregressive transformers trained on tokenized data now represent the state of the art across a range of generative tasks. We extend the discrete modeling paradigm by introducing a particle-level generative model trained on residual-quantized full-event data. We demonstrate the ability of this model family to perform conditional generation from detector-stable particles; we study its scaling behavior across a range of dataset and model sizes, characterize the effects of repeated data exposure and demonstrate that token-level loss systematically predicts downstream physical fidelity. These results provide an empirical framework for scalable collider

translated_title: 基于残差量化标记的对撞机事例生成规模化研究
translated_abstract: 对撞机事例的全探测器模拟与重建预计将成为高亮度大型强子对撞机（HL-LHC）的主要瓶颈，这推动了快速、基于机器学习的替代方法的开发。与此同时，大语言模型推动了生成式离散建模的快速进展：在标记化数据上训练的自回归Transformer如今在一系列生成任务中代表了最先进的水平。我们通过引入一个在残差量化全事例数据上训练的粒子级生成模型，扩展了这一离散建模范式。我们展示了该模型家族从探测器稳定粒子进行条件生成的能力；我们研究了其在不同数据集和模型规模下的扩展行为，刻画了重复数据暴露的影响，并证明标记级损失能够系统性地预测下游的物理保真度。这些结果为可扩展的对撞机事例生成提供了一个经验性框架。
tldr: 该论文首次将残差量化标记与自回归Transformer应用于粒子级对撞机全事例生成，实现了从探测器稳定粒子的条件生成，并系统证明了标记级损失可有效预测物理保真度，为对撞机事例的规模化生成建立了经验框架。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a particle-level generative model trained on residual-quantized full-event data, demonstrating conditional generation from detector-stable particles and establishing that token-level loss systematically predicts downstream physical fidelity, thereby providing an empirical framework for scalable collider event generation.
